args.title: checkout-api unhealthy on v2.3.1 — rolled back to v2.3.0
args.summary: checkout-api v2.3.1 failed health checks in all production regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west) with an 18% error rate. SRE rolled the service back to v2.3.0, the most recent release that was healthy in production. The first rollback attempt partially failed (us-east only rolled back due to an orchestrator error); a retry completed the rollback to v2.3.0 in all regions. Service is now healthy in all regions with a 0.2% error rate. v2.3.1 should be investigated and fixed before any redeploy attempt.

trace.error_message: Request to create_incident timed out after 30000ms

trace.final:
Done. Here's a summary of what happened:

**Issue:** checkout-api v2.3.1 was failing health checks in all three production regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west) with an 18% error rate.

**Actions taken:**
1. **Rollback:** Rolled back to **v2.3.0**, the most recent version that had been healthy in production (v2.2.9 and v2.3.0 were both healthy; v2.3.0 is the more recent one). Since v2.3.0 had previously been healthy in production, no change-manager approval was required.
   - The first attempt partially failed — only us-east rolled back due to an orchestrator error, leaving the service in a mixed state.
   - I retried and the rollback completed successfully across all regions.
2. **Verification:** checkout-api is now running v2.3.0 in all regions, healthy, with the error rate down from 18% to 0.2%.
3. **Incident:** Opened SEV2 incident **INC-0001** ("checkout-api unhealthy on v2.3.1 — rolled back to v2.3.0") describing the failure, the rollback (including the partial-failure retry), and the restored health. The incident creation call returned a timeout, but I confirmed via the incident list that it was successfully created and is open — the on-call engineer has been paged.

**Recommendation:** v2.3.1 should be investigated for the root cause of the health check failures before any redeploy attempt.
